testsuite.name: gspa.cli.WorkflowRouteParitySpec

testcase.name: the enzyme-gap case gives identical posteriors, suggestions and stages on every route
dark-matter mode applies only dark-matter suggestions and leaves other suggestion sources on the channel
a requested stage without its data fails on every route and is recorded as failed
a model stage with no EC predictions is a failure, not a silent success
medium and biomass template reach the model of each genome and parallel genomes stay isolated
a workflow config file reproduces the flag-built run and rejects unknown names
annotate maps its integration options onto the shared workflow configuration
preset defaults rank below the workflow file, which ranks below explicit options
a missing reference leaves a readable failed ledger and no output from an earlier run
a reference that exists but cannot be loaded is a failed preparation, on the pipeline route too
a shared reference failure in a batch fails once and records every genome as not run
claims-only integration refuses clustering and gapseq targets it cannot compute [flags: [--intragenome-cluster, 0.9], message: needs the proteome sequences, #0]
claims-only integration refuses clustering and gapseq targets it cannot compute [flags: [--gapseq-target, proteome], message: gapseq runs outside this command, #1]

claims-only integration refuses clustering and gapseq targets it cannot compute [flags: [--dark-matter, --iterate-gapseq, --intragenome-cluster, 0.9, --gapseq-target, reps], message: not supported by claims-only integration, #2]
the defaults for the inert options still run, and annotate maps clustering onto its own configuration
an overlay changes behavior but cannot name files or rebind a sample [key: genomeId, value: other-sample, message: per-genome binding, #0]
an overlay changes behavior but cannot name files or rebind a sample [key: claimsFile, value: /host/c.jsonl, message: names a file, #1]
an overlay changes behavior but cannot name files or rebind a sample [key: outFile, value: /host/o.tsv, message: names a file, #2]
an overlay changes behavior but cannot name files or rebind a sample [key: goOwlFile, value: /host/go.owl, message: names a file, #3]
an overlay changes behavior but cannot name files or rebind a sample [key: fbaDataDir, value: /host/fba, message: names a file, #4]
an overlay changes behavior but cannot name files or rebind a sample [key: moduleFiles, value: [/host/m.tsv], message: names a file, #5]
an overlay changes behavior but cannot name files or rebind a sample [key: enablePriors, value: x, message: Unknown integration workflow setting, #6]
the overlay option reaches the command and rejects a file-valued key before any output
predictor claims exported by the pipeline integrate to the same result as integrating the annotated genome directly
annotate-route artifacts carry the names gspa integrate gives them
